decision.scope: Static authored-procedure testing for IE286-W1 only. The contract creates no recovered source facts, no general equipment rule and no campaign event.

branchScope.independentBranches: Each case begins from its own exact historical pre-landing state; the three impacts are not successive damage to one shared crate.

testOnlyProfile.construction: Hollow, lightweight wooden lattice container with thin facing and breakable joints; nonmagical.
testOnlyProfile.coordinateConvention: Crate and listed item positions use minimum XYZ corner.
testOnlyProfile.localSupport: Existing ground at z=0 supports the settled 20 lb and remains intact during these two stipulated impacts; no general terrain-strength rule.

contentsManifest.otherContents: none in this explicitly proposed branch

impactRule.authorship: Fixed newly authored object-impact values, not creature fall damage; only these two heights and this exact proposed profile.
impactRule.resolveOnce: One impact per original case/event ID plus crate. No attack roll, critical, additional ascent impact or repeated damage. Contents receive only listed transmitted impact; container overkill does not transfer.

120FootSettlement.crate: Loses enclosing/support function; retain only as a nonphysical lineage record, not an occupying or mass-bearing object.
120FootSettlement.fragmentMeaning: These four clusters represent the entire 18 lb container structure and joints. No further debris is generated. They are broken, nonfunctional remains with no durability or salvage value; further attacks, repair, handling or valuation are outside the contract.

custodyAndConservation.appliesTo: crate, all four physical fragments and the cloth bundle.
custodyAndConservation.fragmentLayoutAndBundleSettlement: Stipulated same-impact aftermath; not teleport, additional falls or separate damage events.

requiredWitnessScopeAfterAdoption.perDelta: Use its exact historical pre-landing state plus a separately declared adopted overlay. Apply impact, breakage and property settlement as same-time substeps at 6.15, preserving 6.133→6.15 landing timing.
requiredWitnessScopeAfterAdoption.evidence: Record full before/after states, stable IDs, mass/custody accounting, and forward/inverse operations. Reverse restoration returns to the adopted branch start; removing the separately recorded overlay returns to exact historical input.
requiredWitnessScopeAfterAdoption.preserve: Unrelated paths, creature outcomes, Feather Fall, casts, clocks and budgets. Do not replay the six historical cases.

proposedOwnerAdoption.wording: I adopt IE286-W1-TEST-CONTRACT-01 exactly as issued against preflight SHA-256 487acbe71a355b33c5c3e7b336c832c0e10fad3ebada7b835d66f2d8f63c378a, including its loaded-mass interpretation, nonempty contents manifest, hypothetical ownership/custody, local geometry/support, durability, fixed impacts and complete aftermath. I authorize only construction and submission of the three minimal W1 TEST_ONLY successor deltas. This establishes no campaign facts or general equipment rule and authorizes no seal, blocker closure, identity acceptance/application, W2 change or queue mutation.
